title: Job (V1)
description: The unit of work: one Device, one Site, one or more Annotations. Target.url is the only required targeting field; every other target field is a best-effort hint.

agentId.description: Optional: pin this round to one authorized agent. The Relay validates it against agent_sites; a job without it keeps the older behaviour.

context.title: Job context (V1)
context.description: Optional, job-wide context for one session. It applies to every annotation and is never a task of its own. Absent on jobs that predate it.

annotation.title: Annotation (V1)
annotation.description: The user is referring to this thing on this page and wants this change.

target.title: Target (V1)
target.description: url is the durable identity. selector, domPath and rect are hints only — never the sole source of truth.
